artboards.title: Deltas: current app vs this design

annotations.text: THE FIVE LAYER PROPERTY PANELS, one system. Full spec: docs/panel-redesign/PANEL-REDESIGN-SPEC.md. L0 accordion bar; group order CONTENT / APPEARANCE / TRANSFORM / EFFECTS where it applies (Fill has no Transform; Canvas has SIZE + ACTIONS). One Transform module, one paint-slot module for every Fill / Border / Shadow / Background, one .asset row, one Opacity row, one Reset Effects footer, one Advanced disclosure per module. Source is always a dropdown. Every boolean is a toggle switch, label left, switch right-aligned to the value column. Concentric radii (8 / 6 / 4 / 3). The revert column is reserved on every ROW; block elements (assets, notes, buttons, footers) span full width. Property labels 11px. Values in editable fields.

WORKSPACE START CARD (#workspaceStart): the centred card on the canvas when nothing is loaded. Distinct from the sidebar Welcome panel to its left. Heading + one sentence, three stacked actions (Open image primary, New canvas, Open project), a dashed drop zone with the size limits. Warmer than a settings surface; still the app's tokens.

AUTO GLITTER WIZARD + LAYERS PANEL.

AUTO GLITTER (autoGlitterSettingsSection): the panel that needs a scroll region. Fixed-height flex column: a PINNED preview mode segmented, a SCROLL region holding Palette (style, colors, merge), Color Matches (a live status line + a list of region -> matched glitter rows, each with a swatch pair, name, match % and a Change chip) and Advanced (detail + two toggles), then a STICKY FOOTER with Cancel / Create N layers. The running spinner sits in a fixed-height status slot so it never reflows the list. Nothing inside the scroll region is a new primitive.

LAYERS PANEL (left side, brought to parity): same Y2K bar with an icon, 'Layers', a count, a New Layer action and a collapse chevron. A layer row is one card: drag dots, a 34px swatch, name + type meta (+ a Masked / Locked badge), then visibility and lock icon buttons. States: active (accent border + tint), selected, is-hidden (dimmed), is-locked (no drag handle). A bottom bar of add / clone / go-to / delete icon buttons in the chrome.

Open: whether the layers list should adopt the same 6px card gap as the property panels' blocks (currently 4).

ASSET BROWSER. Three layouts, chosen by the collection.

GLITTER / STICKERS (category view): header (Back + title + count), search row, a 'By category / Show all' toggle, then a 2-up category folder grid. 'Show all' (its own artboard) is every item visible, grouped under category headers, nothing collapsed.

INSIDE A CATEGORY: the armed PICKER STRIP names the destination with a Done button; Back returns to the list; the active-filter summary has a real 'Clear all' pill; a 4-up asset grid, selected one outlined, animated items badged with a corner play glyph.

SEARCH + FILTER: the filter drawer: each group a .property-group-label over a chip row, hairline dividers, NO cards, NO fourth uppercase level, NO nested scroll. Round swatch chips for colors, pills for the rest. Clear all / Show N results pinned.

BRUSH TIPS: basic brushes listed flat, then Brush SETS as folders. A SET PAGE (its own artboard) is a back line, the set name, the Source & usage credit (label, byline, dot-separated meta, a collapsed Archival note, a links row), then the tips.

SHAPES: too small for folders. Every category shown, grouped under headers, always.

Grid columns are a container query (3 / 4 / 5-up).

CHANGELOG (newest first)

p34: Modal consistency pass. New Canvas rows now use the same 188px control band as Settings / Export Settings. Color fields hug their content (swatch + hex), right-aligned - no dead space beside the hex - in New Canvas + Export Settings. Export Settings gains the identical rule-D reset set as Settings (per-row + per-section shown-when-changed + footer Reset all); footer reset label unified to "Reset all". SPEC gains SS14 Modals: the one modal contract, control band, reset scopes, and a component ledger (kept shell / reused property vocabulary / new modal-only primitives: --ctl-w band, .btn.reset, .stat-grid, .notice-card, .preset-tile, .hairline-list). CODEX-BRIEF + README point at SS14.

p33: Settings reset affordance, rule D, three scopes: per-ROW undo icon (hidden at default, faint on hover, solid when changed - Theme + Reduce motion shown edited); per-SECTION undo icon on the group label, shown only when that section has an edit (Interface yes, Tools no); footer "Reset all settings" restyled - transparent + tertiary + leading undo glyph so it is not a peer of the now-solid Close. Same footer treatment in Export Settings. Export Ready: tightened the reduction-text -> dl gap again (3px).

p32: Settings + Export Settings: ONE control-width band - every control (dropdown, segmented incl. Format, slider+value, colorfield, number, switch) sits in a fixed 188px right-aligned column; nothing stretches modal-wide (matches the app). New Canvas presets regrouped into Square / Portrait / Landscape categories, each a 3-up of the consistent fixed-stage cards.

p26-p31 (modals, superseded detail): gradient handles -> circles on the bar, .num Pos/Alpha, 2-up .btn actions; modal shells -> fixed viewport fraction, one scroll region; color->Color; Export Ready rebuilt toward the app default (stat grid, Large-file card, auto-collapsed "Export details" .disc); Missing Project Content rename + <ul> reset; New Canvas presets -> consistent fixed-stage cards; Shortcuts Keyboard/Gestures toggle restored.

p22-p25 (summary): GradientFill added then reconciled with the live app; Multi-select Align-to segmented + Group dropped; Mask Scatter & Jitter full option set; Transform actions footer + Lock-above-Size on Shape/Sticker/Text; Border/Shadow lose Advanced; Fill Advanced split into Color adjust + Texture position + Anchor; asset-browser empty states; six modal artboards (bodies adopt the panel vocabulary, shell unchanged).

p3-p21 (summary): row grammar + 7 row types; concentric radii (8/6/4/3); one switch mixin; one gutter rule; one collapse glyph (down chevron); Transform Align/Flip folded in; per-slider Reset -> one revert icon; SPEC + component ledger + ARTBOARD-DIFF written; layers panel + Add-layer modal in scope (parity only); Mask panel -> "Mask Settings" (one panel serves brush + eraser); asset summary / Layers row / Auto Glitter match unified; browser nav header one component; Quick Add copy from LAYER_UI_CONFIG; Auto Glitter wizard (scroll + sticky footer); empty + populated states drawn.
